lines.1: It has been about a week since I joined the student council.
lines.2: That alone has made my once-ordinary days hectic.
lines.3: There is one girl I cannot stop thinking about.
lines.4: Yoshimi Sato... better known as Yoppi.
lines.5: With so many fierce people around, Yoshimi is truly a soothing presence.
lines.6: And she seems to be interested in me too.
lines.7: Honestly, having a beautiful girl like Yoshimi like me would make me incredibly happy.
lines.8: I could fall for her in a heartbeat.
lines.9: But how does Yoshimi actually feel about me?
